name: pg_multirangetypes_allow_composite_type
subject: Don't allow composite type to be member of itself via multirange
goal:
A composite type must not be able to contain itself, directly or through another type. That is refused when the path runs through a domain, an array, another composite type or a range type. Through a multirange it is accepted.

To reach it, create a composite type, create a range type over it (which brings a multirange type with it), then add an attribute of that multirange type back to the composite. ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN on a table whose row type is involved gets there the same way.

It has to be refused like the other cases, and the cases already refused must keep being refused.
